purpose: Preserve prior PDF audit outcomes and clearly separate rerunnable repository checks from recorded manual reviews and unfinished verification. This ledger is an index of evidence, not a certification that extraction is production-ready.

evidence_status_definitions.REPRODUCIBLE_AUTOMATED: A repository artifact and command exist to rerun this exact check. Passing this check proves only its stated scope.
evidence_status_definitions.MANUAL_REVIEW_RECORDED: A prior visual/manual review was recorded, but the complete per-page/per-cell reviewer worksheet is not committed as reproducible evidence.
evidence_status_definitions.CROSSCHECK_RECORDED_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE: Prior comparison counts/results were recorded, but the exact scanner inputs/version and executable procedure are not preserved well enough to reproduce those counts.
evidence_status_definitions.INCOMPLETE: The stated verification has not been completed.

evidence.scope: PG62 GC futures rows for 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-14; 27 contract rows per date (81 row-date observations).
evidence.method: Compare the parsed GC row fields against the original PDF table pages, retaining raw markers and signs.
evidence.result: Recorded as complete for the 27 GC rows on each of the three dates. The 2026-10-14 table spans pages 2-3.
limitations: The complete reviewer-by-cell transcription worksheet and rendered-page snapshots are not preserved in the repository as a reproducible audit package.
This historical record is not equivalent to a currently rerunnable parser-to-source reconciliation test.

evidence.scope: All 27 GC contract rows on 2026-10-14 compared with 2026-10-13 settlement values.
evidence.method: Independently recompute settlement(t) - settlement(t-1) and compare with the printed price_change field.
evidence.result: Recorded zero mismatches across 27 contract rows.
limitations: This is a recorded audit outcome, not a substitute for a reproducible test fixture linking each contract and source token.
Arithmetic corroborates values but cannot by itself prove correct column assignment.

evidence.method: Compare source.raw_line with independently tokenized JSON raw fields.
evidence.result: Recorded 27 rows, zero unparsed rows, and zero raw-token mismatches.
limitations: The exact one-off crosscheck code and generated comparison output are not committed as a rerunnable artifact.

evidence.scope: Repository's live COMEX PDF provenance/parser smoke workflow.
evidence.method: Use scripts/test_live_comex_pdfs.py and related provenance validation in the live COMEX PDF smoke workflow.
evidence.result: Prior workflow record: PG62 source matched expected provenance and 8 pages.

This ledger records a prior result; rerun the command/workflow to establish current status.

evidence.method: Review seven contact sheets and high-resolution samples of pages 1-10 and 69-70; additionally inspect PG62 pages 2-3 and 7-8.
evidence.result: Recorded all 70 PG64 pages as visually reviewed. Pages 69-70 are OPTIONS EOO'S AND BLOCKS; page 70 is a continuation page with fewer rows and was not treated as an omission.

details.candidate_rows_pages_69_to_70: Options EOO's and blocks; not included in the 8,317 strike-like-row scan

limitations: Per-page visual reviewer notes and rendered images are not committed as a complete reproducible review package.
Visual page coverage does not certify every extracted option field or canonical contract key.

evidence.scope: Independent candidate-row comparison across all PG64 pages.
evidence.method: Compare PyMuPDF word extraction and pdfplumber word extraction using y-coordinate grouping and candidate rows with 15-17 tokens.
evidence.result: Recorded PyMuPDF 8,529 candidate rows; pdfplumber 8,490; 8,490 y-coordinate matches; 8,480 normalized token-sequence matches; 10 matched rows with token mismatches; 39 PyMuPDF-only rows; 0 pdfplumber-only rows.
limitations: The original scanner source and exact package versions/configuration are not committed; these historical counts are not currently reproducible.
The follow-up investigation script is diagnostic only: token normalization does not reliably rejoin split signs, and greedy y-grouping may merge rows.
Candidate-row counts and token agreement do not prove field-by-field correctness or unique canonical option identifiers.

evidence.scope: Every PG64 option row and each semantic field against original PDF values.
evidence.method: Required future work: build a normalized row/cell inventory, preserve raw tokens and page/coordinates, independently reconcile all rows/fields, and quarantine unresolved values.
evidence.result: Not complete. No same-date normalized master artifact has been fully reconciled cell-by-cell against the PDF.
limitations: PG64 remains diagnostic-only and must not be promoted to a production-quality source based on page review or row-count agreement.

evidence.scope: Promotion of data/definitions/pdf-field-master.json and its layout profiles.
evidence.method: Resolve source semantics and structural fingerprints; validate multiple dates and edge cases; ensure token coverage and independent evidence; rerun golden tests.
evidence.result: Master remains draft (version 0.1.0-draft); PG62 profile is DRAFT_UNVERIFIED and PG64 profile is diagnostic-only.
limitations: Meanings of ----, UNCH, B, detached signs and incomplete layout fingerprints remain unresolved or require explicit reviewed rules.

open_gates.required_to_close: Commit exact raw-token reconciliation fixtures and a command that reruns the 27-row/date comparison against source PDFs.
Preserve scanner implementation, dependency versions, deterministic row grouping, mismatch TSV/JSON, and tests for split signs and merged rows.
Independently reconcile every row and field to the original PDF; zero unexplained mismatches and explicit quarantine for unresolved cells.
Resolve semantics, complete profile fingerprints, pass multi-date golden tests, and keep all unresolved tokens from publication.
